title: Writing – Test 2
q1:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English-speaking friend Angela and the notes you have made.

From: Angela
Subject: Your school!

Hi Jane,

I know you moved to a new school this year. How is your new school?

Have you made any friends?

friend called Julie

It must be difficult at first. Everything is new. You don’t know anyone.

Explain

What are the teachers like? Are they friendly or strict? You are such a good student that you always have a good relationship with them.

Describe …

Is your new school close to your house? Tell me your news.

Tell Angela

Love,

Angela

Write your email to Angela using all the notes.
q2:
You see this notice on an English-language website.

Articles wanted!

An important person

Who is the most important person in your life?

What is he or she like?

Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website.

Write your article.
q3:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence:

I took a deep breath and knocked on the door.

Write your story.

notes.q1: cover all four notes: tell Angela about your new friend Julie; explain how you feel at the new school; describe the teachers; tell Angela whether the school is close to your house.
notes.q2: who the most important person in your life is; what he or she is like; why he or she is important to you.

first: I took a deep breath and knocked on the door.
